data.one_liner: Git command line wrapper for inspecting and manipulating local Git repositories.
data.what_it_does: Exposes a Git directory abstraction in Dart that makes it easy to inspect and manipulate a local Git repository. It provides functions to check commit counts, worktrees, branches, and execute git commands programmatically.
use_when: You need to build a Dart or Flutter tool that interacts with local Git repositories.
You want to programmatically inspect commit history, branches, or check if a working tree is clean.
avoid_when: You need a full Dart implementation of the Git protocol without depending on the system git executable.
You are running on a platform that does not have the git command-line tool installed.
strengths: Provides a clean Dart API over git commands
Supports features like worktrees, branch tracking, and fetching
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Requires the system git executable to be present on the host device
data.setup_notes: Requires the git command-line tool installed and available on the system PATH.
